title: Canonical item matching
lead: Map parsed item text to canonical grocery items with categories and aliases (I6).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the review UI (next slice); order-line matching (Phase 2 reuses this).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: "ground turkey meat" and "ground turkey" must be the same thing on the list. Order lines in Phase 2 will reuse the same matcher.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Seed items, categories and aliases from TOML (ADR 0019).
2. Normalize: lowercase, strip descriptors (fresh, chopped, sliced, …), and singularize with simple rules.
3. Match on exact, then alias, then token overlap (stdlib `difflib` for the score).
4. Return the item with a confidence; below the threshold → review queue.
5. Store results on `ingredient_line.item_id`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Matching tests pass; all fixture ingredients map or are queued.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
